purpose: Keep the final user-facing result stable, concise and evidence-bound without turning every answer into an internal validation dump.
principles: the final answer summarizes the proved task state; it is not a new proof source
the final answer must never upgrade requirements/release/evidence status in prose
show the outcome before implementation detail
do not expose internal ledgers, routing tables or gate inventories by default
omit empty sections and omit user action when the user has nothing to do
artifact links and exact delivery instructions remain part of the result when artifacts were produced
final mandatory DOCX artifacts are qualified from actual post-render/post-publish bytes before final user delivery

common_sections.contract: State the direct answer/result and the strongest justified readiness status in compact form.
Name only material checks/evidence that affect confidence in the delivered result; do not dump every internal gate.
State what is and is not proven. Never imply runtime, deployment or source proof that was not observed.

common_sections.conditional: include only when files, PRs, patches, reports or delivery packages were produced
include only when a concrete next action is required from the user

ANALYSIS_REPORT.use_when: the primary result is analysis/review/recommendation rather than a delivered implementation

code_comparison.when: exact source supports a concrete replacement and code would materially improve the recommendation

rules: group repeated manifestations under one root finding when they have the same owner/cause
keep separate findings when remediation, owner, proof boundary or risk differs
do not inflate the report with low-value style observations when they do not affect the task

IMPLEMENTATION_DELIVERY.use_when: the task produced code, a patch, an importable artifact, a compare set or a manual transfer instruction
rules: select the primary delivery mode before final implementation artifact construction
do not infer IMPORTABLE_ARTIFACT or XML delivery merely from technical ability to construct XML
for accepted human Configurator/extension application with no authorized direct mutation and no exact validated import route, use MANUAL_TRANSFER_INSTRUCTION as the default primary mode
do not restate every changed line; summarize by business/technical responsibility
when manual transfer is primary, preserve the exact ordered object-by-object transfer contract and deliver a separate Инструкция по внедрению.docx
every non-trivial implementation delivers a separate Особенности реализации.docx
when an artifact was created, link or identify the exact artifact and its scope
do not call an artifact deployed or runtime-proven unless that target state was observed

field_rules.procedure_function: exact procedure/function when applicable; otherwise dash
field_rules.status: factual Russian status such as Изменен or Создан, grammatically appropriate to the object
field_rules.change_description: concise implemented functionality plus the applicable evidenced standard/rule

rules: header fields are mandatory and appear exactly once in owner-approved order
five table columns are mandatory and appear exactly in owner-approved order
do not rename, merge, split, remove, reorder or add base columns
do not invent project/task/platform/configuration identity or standard/rule
the DOCX is a presentation artifact and cannot create or upgrade proof

header_field_rules.tz_number: exact task/TZ number from bound task/project context
header_field_rules.configuration_name_version: exact evidenced configuration name and version

format_rules: five header fields are mandatory and appear exactly once in the owner-approved order
header fields must not be repeated as table columns
five base table columns are mandatory and appear exactly in the owner-approved order
do not rename, remove, merge, split or reorder header fields or base table columns
do not add extra columns to the base table
additional supplementary information remains outside the mandatory header and base table
identity_rules: project/task/TZ identity comes only from bound Project Context or requirements
platform/configuration identity comes only from exact evidenced target context
container identity comes from the exact baseline/candidate layout
same-named objects in the main configuration and extensions or different extensions remain separate rows
implementation_notes.trigger_contract: NON_TRIVIAL_IMPLEMENTATION is deterministically applicable; it must not depend on a separate model applicability judgment
implementation_notes.completion_gate: final implementation delivery is incomplete while the separate implementation-notes artifact is missing

performance_review_projection.source_of_truth: canonical release_gate implementation_readiness plus the validated exact-candidate performance_review row; presentation never becomes a proof source

STRUCTURAL_ONLY.rule: may describe structural/asymptotic improvement but must not state measured speedup, latency or throughput improvement

MEASURED.rule: may state the measured claim only when canonical validation accepted an exact-candidate runtime_case verified from RUNTIME_ADAPTER evidence

NOT_APPLICABLE.rule: may be shown only when the canonical exact-candidate plan reports COLLECTION_ALGORITHM inactive and detected_by is empty

BLOCKED.rule: missing, invalid, stale or active-owner NOT_APPLICABLE review must be surfaced as blocked/incomplete and never rendered as a ready Performance Review

rules: render only from canonical validated Performance Review state bound to the same candidate fingerprint
generic prose, generic PASS or a generic receipt is not a Performance Review
STRUCTURAL_ONLY must include the exact disclosure `Измеренное ускорение не доказано.` and must not imply measured acceleration
MEASURED requires verifier-confirmed RUNTIME_ADAPTER evidence for the exact candidate before the measured claim may be rendered
NOT_APPLICABLE is verifier-owned and requires the exact candidate to have COLLECTION_ALGORITHM inactive with no detected activation triggers
missing, stale, wrong-candidate or otherwise blocked Performance Review must remain visibly blocked and cannot be omitted to make delivery look ready
the Performance Review projection cannot change implementation_readiness or final release_outcome
the projection is supplementary and must remain outside the mandatory project/task header and immutable five-column `Особенности реализации` table

manual_transfer_template_rules: render purpose/boundaries before the object-first implementation core
render material do-not-change/do-not-do constraints when applicable
render object-first core in exact order: Создаваемые объекты -> Изменяемые объекты -> Код
created objects include exact material properties and concise rationale/applicable evidenced standard
modified objects show material property changes as Было/Стало
code changes show exact object/member, placement anchor and minimum sufficient Было/Стало fragments with the same integration context
add concise explanation when placement or behavioral effect can reasonably be misunderstood
preserve exact code and canonical AUTHOR_MARKER when applicable
render ordered deployment sequence, verification matrix with expected results, final static-control checklist and changed-object map
leave no material implementation decision silently delegated to the human executor

manual_transfer_artifact_output.proof_boundary: document does not prove target application, deployment/import or runtime behavior
manual_transfer_artifact_output.completion_gate: final manual-transfer delivery is incomplete while the separate instruction artifact is missing

rules: group by exact configuration object and then procedure/function/change unit
include task/TZ relation and exact location when available
diff uses - removed, + added and unmarked unchanged context
generate only when explicit_user_request=true
presentation cannot create or upgrade proof

decision_inputs: authorized and actually available direct mutation mechanism
exact import mechanism and validation boundary
whether a human is expected to apply the change
delivery_mode_selection.xml_capability_rule: ability to generate XML is not evidence that IMPORTABLE_ARTIFACT is the accepted or validated delivery route
manual_transfer_default_when: 1C human Configurator/extension application is the accepted route
direct target mutation is unavailable or not authorized
no exact importable artifact route is proven and validated
importable_artifact_requires: validation boundary for the produced artifact

REQUIREMENTS_ARTIFACT.use_when: the primary deliverable is a requirements/specification/technical assignment artifact
rules: preserve agreed requirement versus proposed solution provenance
a blocked requirements gate must be visible in OUTCOME/PROOF_BOUNDARY rather than hidden in an appendix
template_rules: render Russian human-facing labels for a Russian user/project
keep agreed requirements, material OPEN items, assumptions and proposed solution distinct
do not render internal authoring invariants into the customer document
render readiness only from the canonical requirements gate

artifact_output.trigger: requested/required human-readable requirements or functional specification
artifact_output.source_of_truth: canonical executable requirements contract and requirements gate

BLOCKED_OR_PARTIAL.use_when: a blocking gate/evidence dependency remains or only part of the requested result can be completed
rules: never use ready/proven/completed wording for the blocked portion
request the smallest concrete artifact or answer that can resolve the blocker
do not ask the user to repeat context already present in the active task
use the canonical gate/validator outcome for the property it owns
BLOCKED must not become ready in prose
READY_FOR_RUNTIME_TEST must not become runtime-proven in prose
ANALYSIS_COMPLETE is analysis coverage, not deployment/runtime proof
PROVEN applies only at the exact proof scope returned by the release gate
ProjectSnapshot package ACCEPTED proves binding/provenance only; source bytes still require content inspection
delivery artifact validation does not imply applied-target, deployment/import or runtime observation

user_artifact_format.default_language_encoding: Russian UTF-8 for a Russian user/project
user_artifact_format.identifier_preservation: exact source identifiers, code, paths, hashes, API names and machine tokens remain literal
user_artifact_format.filename_rule: do not use pseudo-version suffixes such as v2/final/fix/new; revision belongs in metadata/history
user_artifact_format.proof_rule: user-facing presentation cannot create or upgrade canonical requirements/evidence/release proof
user_artifact_format.contract: Applicable user-facing documentation artifacts are separate DOCX projections. For non-trivial implementation, implementation_notes is always applicable; for MANUAL_TRANSFER_INSTRUCTION, manual_transfer is always applicable. Canonical machine/proof artifacts remain native and DOCX cannot create or upgrade proof.

final_docx_set_validation.purpose: Prove the actual final mandatory DOCX set from current published bytes; pre-render release evidence cannot qualify files that did not yet exist.

required_kind_derivation.requirements: required only when requirements_artifact_required=true under the existing requirements artifact trigger
required_kind_derivation.line_by_line: required only when line_by_line_requested=true under EXPLICIT_USER_REQUEST_ONLY
required_kind_derivation.combined_alternate: never substitutes for any required separate kind

canonical_path_contract.rule: every required kind maps exactly to Output/<owner filename>.docx; paths must be canonical relative package paths and regular non-symlink files

file_checks: required kind resolves to the exact owner-approved relative Output path
regular non-symlink .docx file exists and is non-zero
size and SHA-256 are computed from final bytes after publish
immediate read-back bytes and SHA-256 match the verified bytes
OOXML ZIP container contains valid [Content_Types].xml, _rels/.rels, word/document.xml and docProps/core.xml with a valid main-document relationship
distinct required kinds resolve to distinct files
exact duplicate bytes cannot satisfy semantically distinct required kinds

current_binding.embedded_in: DOCX core property dc:identifier at render time
current_binding.package_binding_rule: package_binding_sha256 binds the already-settled delivery/change package identity before final DOCX receipt construction; it is not a hash of the final receipt and must not create circular hashing
current_binding.rule: the final verifier requires exact equality to the current task/candidate/package/change_items/result_mode/artifact kind so stale prior-task/prior-candidate/prior-change DOCX bytes cannot close the obligation

publication_binding.local_file: verify the declared publication path resolves inside package_root and hashes to the same final bytes
publication_binding.platform_attachment: record the attachment/reference and mark byte identity REQUIRES_ROUTE_E2E when repository CI cannot independently read the platform attachment bytes
publication_binding.missing_reference: invalid; final verification is post-publish and requires a declared publication reference

receipt.rule: receipt projects final byte identity only; it does not duplicate requirements/design/change maps and is not included in package_binding_sha256

proof_boundary: DOCX byte hash and OOXML structure do not prove semantic fidelity to settled Intent/change_items
semantic fidelity and literal changed-code/anchor agreement remain under existing delivery semantic review
final DOCX proof does not prove applied target, deployment/import or runtime behavior
platform attachment byte identity remains REQUIRES_ROUTE_E2E unless the platform exposes independently readable bytes
ordering_rules: primary result mode is selected before final artifact construction
render all required separate DOCX artifacts
run final_docx_set validator against actual final bytes
only then deliver the final user result
a pre-render release receipt, filename label or file-existence claim cannot replace final byte verification
